objective: Generalize the r = 2 triple-system dichotomy to every coprime cyclic action: G = N x| C_r with N = exp(n), n a graded nilpotent Lie algebra over F_p of class at most 4 with a grading-preserving C_r action, p >= 5, c < p, r | p - 1; closed 3-manifolds with H1(M; F_p) = 0 and a bounded number of quotient-character sectors (sector orders d | r). Test and prove or refute the criterion: polynomial iff, for every occurring sector order d, (P2) [n_chi, n_chi'] = 0 whenever chi, chi', chi chi' are nontrivial and (P3) [[n_chi, n_chi^-1], n_eta] = 0 for nontrivial chi, eta; #P-hard otherwise. Start with the polynomial side; address the r > 2 cross-summand and base terms and the total count across sectors; state precisely what is proved. Consolidate the corrected class-(K), beyond-class-2 and triple-system arguments with the generalization into a self-contained presentation for independent review (Artin reverse-product correction, sector-count assumption visible; classical ingredients, literature, finite validation and uniform obligations kept distinct; r counts action characters, not Boolean variables). Requested by the owner via Codex on 2026-10-27 ('Go ahead ... No time constraints').
status: Complete: (P2_d) means the C_d action collapses to an involution; with (P3_d) counting is polynomial in every class (A, no grading); under (P2_d) a surviving (near) triple makes counting #P-hard at every sector order on d/p-surgeries (C, graded, class at most 4; base and steering supported by B). With class (K) and the cross-layer pair this decides graded class at most 4 except pair failures in classes 3-4. Consolidated corrected presentation in D. Next (pair failures in classes 3-4, 2/3) awaits the owner.
stop_rule: Stop when the criterion is proved, refuted by a counterexample, or reduced to a precisely stated substantive obstruction for a stated range, and the consolidated presentation is complete.
title: Counting maps to graded nilpotent-by-cyclic groups of class at most 4: the pair-and-triple criterion
